# LocalFirst Tools MCP Registry

Public MCP server discovery; no servers are executed by this catalog.
Pages base: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools
Raw fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/localFirstTools/main
API directory: data/mcp-registry/
Index: registry.json
Servers: api/v1/servers.json
Status: api/v1/status.json
Badge: api/v1/badge.json
Verified chain: chain.jsonl
Head: orient.json
Offline rebuild: python3 data/mcp-registry/build.py
Inputs: manifest.json, rappid.json (minted once), servers/*.json
Immutable snapshots: versions/<name>/<first-12-sha256-hex><extension>
Tool metadata is a reviewed discovery subset, not a live tools/list response.
